lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y4Ag8Te12 (reduced formula YAg2Te3) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies octahedral coordination throughout: Ag centers have six Te neighbors, Te centers have six neighbors (three Ag and three Y), and Y centers have six Te neighbors, all near 2.89–2.90 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Te–Te octahedra sharing corners and edges, Ag–Y octahedra sharing edges, and Ag–Ag octahedra sharing corners.
